popular.description: 获取最近 7 天热门 COS 图集

actions.code: (() => { const page = Math.max(1, Number('{{page}}' || 1)); const limit = 20; const offset = (page - 1) * limit; return '{{baseUrl}}/wp-json/wordpress-popular-posts/v1/popular-posts?offset=' + offset + '&limit=' + limit + '&range=last7days&embed=true&_embed=wp:featuredmedia&_fields=title,link,_embedded,_links.wp:featuredmedia'; })();

(() => { const decode = (value) => { const box = document.createElement('textarea'); box.innerHTML = String(value || ''); return box.value.trim(); }; const normalizeId = (href) => { try { return new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?cosplaytele\.com/i, '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; let data = []; try { data = JSON.parse(document.body.innerText || document.body.textContent || '[]'); } catch (e) { data = []; } const results = data.map((item) => { const href = item && item.link ? item.link : ''; const media = item && item._embedded && item._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && item._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0] ? item._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0] : null; return { id: normalizeId(href), title: decode(item && item.title ? item.title.rendered : ''), cover: media && media.source_url ? media.source_url : '', url: href, genre: 'Cosplay' }; }).filter((item) => item.id && item.title); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

latest.description: 获取最新 COS 图集

actions.code: (() => { const page = Math.max(1, Number('{{page}}' || 1)); return page <= 1 ? '{{baseUrl}}/' : '{{baseUrl}}/page/' + page + '/'; })();

(() => { const normalizeId = (href) => { try { return new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?cosplaytele\.com/i, '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-lazy-src', 'data-src', 'data-original', 'src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const value = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (value && !value.startsWith('data:image')) return new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href; } return ''; }; const results = []; document.querySelectorAll('main div.box').forEach((box) => { const link = box.querySelector('h5 a') || box.querySelector('.post-title a') || box.querySelector('a[href]'); const img = box.querySelector('img'); if (!link) return; const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const title = (link.textContent || link.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim(); const id = normalizeId(href); if (id && title) results.push({ id, title, cover: pickImage(img), url: new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').href, genre: 'Cosplay' }); }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

(() => { const page = Math.max(1, Number('{{page}}' || 1)); const keyword = String('{{searchKeyword}}' || '{{query}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(keyword)) { try { const url = new URL(keyword); if ((url.hostname === 'cosplaytele.com' || url.hostname === 'www.cosplaytele.com') && (url.pathname.startsWith('/category/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/tag/'))) { const path = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/g, '') + '/page/' + page + '/'; return url.origin + path + url.search; } return keyword; } catch (e) {} } const url = new URL(page <= 1 ? '{{baseUrl}}/' : '{{baseUrl}}/page/' + page + '/'); if (keyword) url.searchParams.set('s', keyword); return url.href; })();

(() => { const normalizeId = (href) => { try { return new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?cosplaytele\.com/i, '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-lazy-src', 'data-src', 'data-original', 'src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const value = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (value && !value.startsWith('data:image')) return new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href; } return ''; }; const results = []; const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('main div.box'); if (boxes.length > 0) { boxes.forEach((box) => { const link = box.querySelector('h5 a') || box.querySelector('.post-title a') || box.querySelector('a[href]'); const img = box.querySelector('img'); if (!link) return; const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const title = (link.textContent || link.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim(); const id = normalizeId(href); if (id && title) results.push({ id, title, cover: pickImage(img), url: new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').href, genre: 'Cosplay' }); }); } else { const title = (document.querySelector('.entry-title')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (title) { const href = window.location.href; results.push({ id: normalizeId(href), title, cover: pickImage(document.querySelector('.gallery-item img')) || pickImage(document.querySelector('.wp-post-image')), url: href, genre: 'Cosplay' }); } } return JSON.stringify(results); })();

getMangaDetail.description: 获取 COS 图集详情

actions.code: (() => { let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw + '/'; })();

(() => { const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-lazy-src', 'data-src', 'data-original', 'src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const value = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (value && !value.startsWith('data:image')) return new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href; } return ''; }; const title = (document.querySelector('.entry-title')?.textContent || document.title || '').replace(/\s*-\s*CosplayTele\s*$/i, '').trim(); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#main a[href*="/tag/"], #main a[href*="/category/"]')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const cover = pickImage(document.querySelector('.gallery-item img')) || pickImage(document.querySelector('.wp-post-image')) || document.querySelector('meta[property="og:image"]')?.getAttribute('content') || ''; return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: '', status: 'completed', description: title, genre: tags.join(', ') }); })();

getChapterList.description: 获取章节列表（每个 COS 图集只有一个 Gallery 章节）

actions.code: (() => { let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw + '/'; })();

(() => { const href = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href') || window.location.href; let id = ''; try { id = new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { id = String(href || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?cosplaytele\.com/i, '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } const date = (document.querySelector('time.updated')?.getAttribute('datetime') || '').split('T')[0] || ''; return JSON.stringify([{ id, title: 'Gallery', url: '{{baseUrl}}/' + id + '/', publishTime: date, date }]); })();

(() => { let raw = String('{{chapterId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw + '/'; })();

(() => { const pages = []; const seen = []; const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const link = img.closest('a[href]'); if (link) { const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (/\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png)(\?|#|$)/i.test(href)) return new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').href; } const attrs = ['data-lazy-src', 'data-src', 'data-original', 'src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const value = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (value && !value.startsWith('data:image')) return new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href; } return ''; }; document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item img').forEach((img) => { const imageUrl = pickImage(img); if (imageUrl && seen.indexOf(imageUrl) < 0) { seen.push(imageUrl); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url: imageUrl, imageUrl }); } }); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
